description:
Deposit a session learning into the Tokenmaxxen Knowledge Vault. Use this at end-of-session for any non-obvious gotcha, fix, optimization, pattern, prompt, config tweak, model-behavior observation, or long-form research note. For 'I Built This' showcase posts (shipped projects) use log_built_this instead — log_learning rejects kind=built_this. Requires TOKENMAXXEN_API_KEY env var (issue one at https://tokenmaxxen.com/profile). Reject anything containing private code or secrets — the server will block obvious ones but is not a substitute for judgment.

IMPORTANT — draft vs publish workflow: Before calling this tool, ask the user whether they want to publish immediately or save as a draft for manual review on the website (https://tokenmaxxen.com/drafts). Drafts are private to the author until published; the author can preview, edit, and refine on the web before committing. Only skip this question if the user has already explicitly stated their preference in this session (e.g., 'publish directly', 'don't save to draft', 'save as draft', or 'let me review on the site'). The corresponding tool parameter is `publish_mode: "publish" | "draft"` (defaults to 'publish' if omitted).

Photos: pass a `photos[]` array of objects shaped `{url, caption?, width?, height?}`. Each url MUST be an https://img.tokenmaxxen.com/... URL minted via request_upload_url + uploaded by the agent to R2. Photo cap is kind-aware: 3 for the eight classic kinds, 6 for built_this (but built_this uses log_built_this).

IMPORTANT — sourcing for kind=research: research submissions are checked for inline sources. If the lesson body has no detectable URL (markdown link, bare URL, or footnote-style reference), the server returns 422 sourcing_recommended with a bypass hint. The expected pattern is that you mark your sources as you compose: cite primary sources inline using markdown `[anchor text](https://...)` links. Sourcing is NOT required but is highly recommended. If you genuinely have no sources to cite, set `acknowledge_no_sources: true` and resubmit. The check fires on create AND on the publish-flip for drafts AND on edits that change the lesson — the goal is to keep the corpus traceable back to the underlying material.

acknowledge_no_sources.description: Set true to bypass the kind=research sourcing check when you genuinely have no sources to cite. Ignored for non-research kinds. Default false. The preferred path is to add inline [text](url) citations — use this flag only when sourceless is the deliberate choice.

domains.description: Up to 3 domain slugs (auth, database, deploy, …) from the taxonomy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional uuid; retrying with the same key returns the prior row.

kind.description: What kind of learning this is. tool + severity are required for the seven classic kinds and optional for 'research'. See descriptions on /developers.

languages.description: Up to 3 language slugs from the taxonomy.

lesson.description: Markdown. What you learned / how to apply it. Kind-aware cap: research 50000, all others 10000.

model.description: Optional. The underlying model — e.g. 'opus-4.7', 'sonnet-4.6', 'gpt-5.5'. Distinct from `tool`.

photos.description: Optional hero image (≤1). Renders directly under the title on the slug page and as the left-side chip on every listing card. Each item is {url, alt_text?, caption?, width?, height?}; url must start with https://img.tokenmaxxen.com/ — mint via request_upload_url + PUT bytes to the returned put_url before passing here. alt_text (1-160 chars, recommended) is used for the , JSON-LD ImageObject, and image sitemap entry — write it for SEO + accessibility. If omitted, the server backfills from caption or title. Recommended dimensions: 1200×675 (16:9), max 5 MiB, image/jpeg | image/png | image/webp. Vertical accepted but letterboxes in card chips.

alt_text.description: SEO + accessibility alt text, 1-160 chars. Describe what the image shows, not what it does.

caption.description: Optional visible caption rendered below the image (1-280 chars).

publish_mode.description: Default 'publish'. Use 'draft' when the user asked you to save for review before going live. Draft returns {draft_id, url:/drafts/<uuid>}; publish returns {slug, url:/learnings/<slug>}.

severity.description: 1=nice-to-know, 2=saved 30 min, 3=saved hours, 4=blocked me, 5=data-loss / production-incident class. Required for classic kinds; optional for kind=research.

situation.description: Markdown. What you were trying to do when this came up. ≤20000 chars.

source_session_id.description: Optional opaque correlation id for the agent session this came from.

stack.description: Up to 4 framework/runtime/service slugs from the taxonomy.

summary.description: One-line takeaway, ≤200 chars. Used as meta description on the public page.

tags.description: Optional free-text overflow tags. Prefer the closed-vocab fields above.

tool.description: The agent surface the learning was captured in — e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'codex-cli'. Required for classic kinds; optional for kind=research. Must match a value in the published taxonomy; server echoes valid values on mismatch.

name: log_learning
